oliva--serie-v-melanio.description: Named for Melanio Oliva, the first in the family to grow tobacco, this box-pressed Nicaraguan blend rests under a dark Sumatra-seed wrapper grown in Ecuador, with Jalapa leaf in the filler. Expect toasted bread and dark chocolate, lifted by black pepper and a soft, milky coffee note.

thirds.notes: A milder, fragrant start: leather and cedar with a dash of black pepper.
A caramel sweetness moves to the centre, joined by coffee and a peanut-like nuttiness.
The richest third: leather returns alongside cedar, cocoa and a lingering coffee note.

sources.title: Davidoff of Geneva – Oliva Serie V Melanio No. 4
The Cigar Authority – Serie V Melanio Robusto review

oliva--serie-v-melanio-maduro.description: The maduro version of the Melanio, built in Nicaragua on a dark San Andrés wrapper from Mexico, with a Nicaraguan binder and sun-grown Jalapa filler. It smokes rich and full, opening on espresso and dark chocolate and turning to leather and sharper pepper as it burns, a cigar for a long evening.

thirds.notes: Strong espresso and bitter chocolate over cedar, with black pepper on the retrohale.
The coffee softens toward mocha, nutty and earthy tones join, and the pepper steps back.
Strength rises; leather and oak come forward and the pepper returns with more bite.

sources.title: Oliva Cigar Co. – Serie V Melanio Maduro
After Action Cigars – Serie V Melanio Maduro Robusto review

oliva--serie-v.description: A Nicaraguan puro introduced in 2007, rolled with Jalapa Valley ligero in the filler, a Nicaraguan binder and a sun-grown Habano wrapper. Dense and rich, it moves from spice and cedar through coffee and chocolate, and gains strength steadily toward the end.

thirds.notes: A rich, spicy opening of coffee and cedar, with pepper waking up the palate.
Coffee and dark chocolate settle in, with leather beneath and pepper returning.
Espresso and bitter chocolate dominate as spice and heat build to full strength.

sources.title: Oliva Cigar Co. – Serie V
Gotham Cigars – Oliva Serie V review
KC Cigar Review – Oliva Serie V Torpedo

oliva--serie-v-maduro.description: Serie V filler of Nicaraguan Jalapa ligero and a Nicaraguan binder, wrapped in maduro leaf from Mexico's San Andrés valley. It starts intense and peppery, then calms into cocoa and espresso with a bittersweet edge, for a smoker who likes a dark, powerful cigar.

thirds.notes: An intense start of dark wood, paprika-like spice and black pepper.
Smoother and more balanced, with cacao and espresso and the pepper gone.
Bittersweet cocoa holds on and black pepper comes back on the retrohale.

sources.title: Oliva Cigar Co. – Serie V Maduro
Bespoke Unit – Oliva Serie V Maduro Especial review

oliva--serie-o.description: A Nicaraguan puro under a sun-grown Habano wrapper, with Cuban-seed tobacco from Estelí, Condega and the Jalapa Valley. It opens earthy with cedar and light pepper, picks up cocoa and espresso in the middle and closes on cedar and nuts, an easy everyday cigar.

thirds.notes: Earth leads, with cedar on the aroma and white pepper through the nose.
A cocoa sweetness develops and espresso appears, while pepper stays on the retrohale.
Cedar takes over, with nuts, espresso and a dark-chocolate finish.

sources.title: Oliva Cigar Co. – Serie O
The Cigar Authority – Oliva Serie O Robusto review

oliva--serie-o-maduro.description: The Serie O blend of sun-grown Nicaraguan binder and filler, finished in a Connecticut Broadleaf maduro wrapper whose natural sweetness smooths a full body. Dark chocolate, cedar and baking spice lead, with dark fruit and espresso arriving later, so it suits an after-dinner hour.

thirds.notes: Dark chocolate and cedar with cinnamon-like spice, pecan and a hint of red fruit.
Fuller and stronger: deeper chocolate, espresso, prune-like fruit and black pepper.
Strength eases; coffee and chocolate-cedar finish on a creamy note.

sources.title: Oliva Cigar Co. – Serie O Maduro
Kaplowitz – Oliva Serie O Maduro review

oliva--serie-g.description: A Cameroon wrapper over a Nicaraguan binder and filler gives this long-running Oliva line its gentle sweetness. Medium in body, it keeps to cedar, nuts and soft spice, gaining leather and a little cocoa as it burns, which makes it a calm choice for any time of day.

thirds.notes: Smooth nuts and wood with light spice and a soft peppery edge.
Earth and leather grow, carried by a light creaminess.
Cocoa appears and the pepper lifts slightly, while the smoke stays smooth.

sources.title: Oliva Cigar Co. – Serie G
Online Cigars – Oliva Serie G Churchill review

oliva--serie-g-maduro.description: A box-pressed maduro with a Mexican wrapper and binder over sun-grown Nicaraguan filler. Medium in body and steady from start to finish, it offers wood, cedar and pepper with leather and a touch of earth on a creamy smoke, a dependable daily maduro.

sources.title: Oliva Cigar Co. – Serie G Maduro
Stogie Review – Oliva Serie G Maduro blind tasting
Klaro Cigars – Oliva Serie G Maduro review

thirds.notes: Doughy, with chocolate-covered espresso, dry wood and a whisper of black cherry.
Mocha stays in check behind dry wood, with fig-like sweetness and a milky walnut note.
A chewy, earthy maduro character with a simple, straightforward finish.

oliva--connecticut-reserve.description: Released in 2009, this is Oliva's mellow line: an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and long filler. Nutty and toasty with a light salty edge, it deepens into coffee and a little pepper by the end, a gentle morning cigar.

thirds.notes: Salted pistachio and almond over toasted bread, with a faint zest.
The nuttiness grows, toast strengthens and coffee grounds add a slight bitterness.
Deeper and fuller, with rye-bread notes, a licorice-like sweetness and pepper on the retrohale.

sources.title: Oliva Cigar Co. – Connecticut Reserve
Bespoke Unit – Oliva Connecticut Reserve review

oliva--master-blends-3.description: First released in 2006 as the third Master Blends edition and later added to the regular range, this blend pairs a sun-grown Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper with a Nicaraguan Habano binder and ligero filler. Creamy and oily, it layers earth, cedar and sweet spice over black coffee, with a long finish.

thirds.notes: Savoury earth and wood with an early burst of black pepper and some almond sweetness.
Sweet spice and aromatic cedar lead, with black coffee and dark chocolate.
Coffee and cinnamon-like spice over earth, with a resinous wood note to close.

sources.title: Oliva Cigar Co. – Master Blends 3
Bespoke Unit – Oliva Master Blends 3 review
Stogie Review – Oliva Master Blends 3 Robusto

oliva--gilberto-oliva-reserva.description: Named for the Oliva family patriarch, this blend sets a dark, oily Sumatra wrapper over an Ecuadorian binder and aged Nicaraguan filler. Medium to full, it shows earth, leather and cocoa with nutty tones and espresso, and a sweetness that stays on the palate.

thirds.notes: A licorice-like sweetness with almond and peanut, coffee, earth and pepper on the retrohale.
Espresso with a creamy finish and almond, while cedar shows through the nose.
The sweet note returns with espresso, earth and nuts, and a short finish.

sources.title: Oliva Cigar Co. – Gilberto Oliva Reserva
The Cigar Authority – Gilberto Oliva Reserva Toro review

oliva--gilberto-oliva-reserva-blanc.description: Launched in 2017 as the lighter sibling of the Gilberto Oliva Reserva, with an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper and binder over Nicaraguan filler. Mild to medium, it gives salted nuts, hay and creamy oak with nougat-like sweetness and a bright touch of citrus, for a relaxed daytime smoke.

thirds.notes: Salted peanuts, hay and a little dark cocoa, with sweetness on the finish and white pepper.
Creamy oak and espresso lead, with leather, hay and flashes of citrus as the pepper fades.
The sweetness softens; oak, hay and creamy nuts remain and white pepper returns.

sources.title: Oliva Cigar Co. – Gilberto Oliva Reserva Blanc
halfwheel – Oliva Gilberto Reserva Blanc Corona

oliva--flor-de-oliva.description: The original blend of Oliva's value line, made at the family's factory in Nicaragua with an Indonesian wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler. Medium in body and without bite, it keeps to a smooth, creamy and earthy profile, an easy cigar for every day.

sources.title: Oliva Cigar Co. – Flor de Oliva

oliva--flor-de-oliva-gold.description: The lightest member of the Flor de Oliva family, made in Nicaragua with an Ecuadorian wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler. It is smooth and soft on the palate with a short finish, made for relaxed, casual smoking or for those new to cigars.

sources.title: Oliva Cigar Co. – Flor de Oliva Gold
Stogie Review – Flor de Oliva Gold

thirds.notes: Natural Nicaraguan tobacco with toasty, buttery aftertastes and a little spice through the nose.
The tobacco grows richer, toast and butter deepen and the spice rises slightly.
Butter and toast remain, and a mild woody note appears for the first time.

oliva--flor-de-oliva-corojo.description: A long-filler Flor de Oliva blend wrapped in Ecuadorian-grown Corojo leaf, with a Nicaraguan binder and filler. Medium in body, it leads with toasty cedar and gains black pepper and Corojo spice as it burns, a robust but easy everyday cigar.

thirds.notes: Cedar with a tangy finish and a light, semi-sweet spice.
The tang fades, light black pepper appears and the tobacco grows richer.
Corojo tobacco takes the lead as the cedar recedes and the pepper sharpens into spice.

sources.title: Oliva Cigar Co. – Flor de Oliva Corojo
Stogie Review – Flor de Oliva Corojo

oliva--flor-de-oliva-maduro.description: The dark member of the Flor de Oliva family, made in Nicaragua with an Ecuadorian maduro wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler. Oliva describes an earthy profile with a satisfying finish and a steady burn, which suits an uncomplicated, everyday smoke.

sources.title: Oliva Cigar Co. – Flor de Oliva Maduro
